title: Must, Must Not and Because
label: ch:ta-must-must-not-and-because
canDo: I can say what someone must, must not or need not do with pōka vēṇṭum, pōkak kūṭātu and vara vēṇṭām, and give a reason with vantatāl, ēṉeṉṟāl and kāraṇam.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 287: give advice with must and must not, and the reason for it, before or after the result.
